_doc: Curator P4 self-iterating-loop policy as DATA (Captain-owned). The monthly in-process curator job (omniseek.core.infra_jobs.run_curator) + the discovery engine (discover.py) READ these numbers; they bake in NO admit/reject/keep/prune/pursue threshold (that would violate the razor exactly as a Captain Y/N prompt would). This file carries ONLY anti-runaway knobs + the enabled flags; it contains NO verdict word. Ships INERT (enabled:false, cold_start.enabled:false) so the loop is near-idle until Captain declares coverage_targets.json AND flips enabled:true (spec section 0).
_enabled_doc: Master switch for the discovery rings. While false, discover.discover() returns [] and the cron does only: read dossier -> compute STOP/coverage facts -> diff-gated Bark -> write run-summary state. It manufactures no candidates. Flip true ONLY after declaring coverage_targets.json.

cold_start._doc: Cold-start web-seeding (a coverage_targets cell whose domain has NO in-corpus source, so the citation graph cannot reach it) is the ONLY non-trust-inherited path. Ships OFF. When on, it is hard-capped at 'budget' seed searches per run, routed through the eye's own bounded fetcher / safe_fetch, and emits URL-less STUBS only -- NEVER an auto-admit (global lesson 4/5: do not trust cold-start from assumption; validate a manual round first).

_M_doc: STOP requires this many CONSECUTIVE demonstrably-HEALTHY monthly rounds with zero net-new placed cells (Attack-3). A degraded / API-outage round FREEZES the streak (neither increments nor resets), so an outage month never masquerades as saturation.
_discover_topn_doc: Per-seed (round-robin per CELL, not global) rate limit on inner-engine citation-graph fan-out. Ranking by (in_degree, cited_by) is a RATE-LIMIT, never a quality filter: dropped candidates are recorded as discovery_truncated / dropped_count so the agent can request a deeper round.
_min_cadence_doc: Cron step 0 min-interval guard (Attack-4): a run within this window of the last discovery run is a clean no-op, so the monthly cadence is a real rate limit instead of an aspiration defeated by RunAtLoad restart storms during dev redeploys.
_error_retry_doc: After this many CONSECUTIVE probe failures a candidate moves to the terminal probe_dead state (Attack-4): a dead host / persistent SSRF block / always-timeout is not re-probed forever, and NOT marked rejected (no agent judged it). Its canonical host joins tried_hosts.json.
_watching_doc: A 'watching' candidate (agent deferred a verdict) gets a TTL + a re-probe budget (Attack-4 cost bound). Past either, the cron routes it to rejected with reason 'watch-expired', so the recurring re-probe set cannot grow into an unbounded fetch against possibly-now-hostile hosts.
_max_new_probes_doc: Per-run ceiling on how many freshly-discovered 'new' rows the cron will probe in one monthly round (bounded fan-out; the remainder wait for next round). Anti-runaway limit 3 of 4.

coverage_ceiling._doc: Per-cell occupancy CEILING (Attack-3: bound the ceiling, not just the floor). Discovery does NOT seed the inner engine from a cell already at/over its ceiling (a well-covered cell is done; it is not a discovery target). The packet surfaces cell_at_ceiling so the agent admits to a full cell ONLY by replacement (baseline_ref.displaces). Per-domain overrides may be added beside _default.

service_gap_floor._doc: Reference numbers for the P2 service-gap signal (a cell whose sole occupant is occupied-but-WEAK: low presence_rate / high timeout_rate / high from_index_only). These bound which single-occupant cells the cron surfaces as 'underserved, want a 2nd source'. They are LABELED reference numbers, never an admit/reject verdict; the agent still chooses its own interpretation.
